notes.title: Campaign - Big update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33230583/a6b43176b42b3b62d9403c4c4aba16d8f1e39163.jpg[/img]

To make the quiz even more interesting, we decided to add to It the mode "on passing", that is - Campaign!
Now you can go through the game from beginning to end on paired subjects, gradually increasing the number of questions at each level.
For the passage of the Campaign you get extra points and new achievements!

Also, in addition to the new mode, we have added some new questions on biology and mathematics.

notes.title: Small Quiz update!
notes.content:
Today released a small but important update to our game)
In it, we have added the option "Show correct answer" to the wrong answer shows which of the answers was correct.
Just corrected a few mistakes on the issues.
Try!
Do not forget to write reviews and your opinions and suggestions for the game. This is important for us and we will try to improve the game as much as possible!
